Newsom Targets Trump
On Monday, Newsom said on
X
that California had enacted the "STRONGEST data center protections in the nation."
"We’re protecting Californians from higher costs and giving communities more control over their electricity, water, and land," he added.
He contrasted California’s approach with Trump’s policies, saying the president "pushes deregulation and lets industry reap massive profits at the expense of working people."
"We’re making sure Californians remain in the driver’s seat," Newsom added.

Last week, Newsom ordered officials to
and develop recommendations for an emergency “kill switch” for frontier AI models.
Newsom’s order directs officials to implement recently enacted laws establishing independent AI verification organizations and a registry for AI auditors.
Experts will also study whether frontier AI companies should have independent evaluators onsite and whether advanced models need emergency shutdown mechanisms.
"The federal government’s abject failure to create any form of meaningful AI oversight or accountability should alarm every American," Newsom said.
He added, "With Donald Trump and Congress failing to lead, California is stepping up to keep all Americans safe."
